title: polygala major subsp. baetica
intro: Polygala major subsp. baetica, commonly known as Baetic polygala or Spanish jointgrass, is a plant species in the Polygalaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to the Iberian Peninsula, traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Polygala major subsp. baetica include its ability to support immune function and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
